title: デビュー戦の後に・喧嘩道中始まりでい

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One goes all out in her debut race. Super Creek and Oguri Cap, who came to watch, praise her for her spectacular performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even after the race, Inari One's excitement remains at a burning high. She's ready and motivated to start training for her next race!
